chunks.title: CLO 2026 Academic Month   CLO, Reshaping the Fashion Classroom
chunks.content: ## CLO 2026 Academic Month: CLO, Reshaping the Fashion Classroom This document covers the key features, technical explanations, and workflows demonstrated in the CLO 2026 software update, focusing on GPU simulation, model shape adjustments, pattern generation, fabric application, animation, and new tools like the 3D pen and belt dresser. It provides detailed procedures and examples for fashion design using CLO software. --- ## GPU vs CPU Simulation Enhancements in CLO 2024.2 This section explains the improvements to GPU simulation in CLO version 2024.2, highlighting the benefits of GPU over CPU simulation for multi-layer clothing and complex garments. - **Multi-tasking simulation improvements:** Before version 2024.2, multi-layer clothing simulations primarily used CPU, limiting speed. - **GPU simulation advantages:** GPU simulation runs significantly faster than CPU simulation due to graphics card performance. - **Demonstration:** Side-by-side comparison shows GPU simulation is consistently faster and behaves similarly to CPU simulation. - **Stability:** GPU simulation supports stable simulation of multi-layered fabrics. - **Recommendation:** From version 2024.2 onward, GPU simulation is recommended for complex clothing projects. --- ## Model Shape Adjustment for Tight Clothing This section describes how to adjust virtual model body shapes in CLO to better fit tight garments such as underwear, lingerie, and yoga clothes. - **Adjustable areas:** Head, hands, buttocks, chest, back, and waistline (male models). - **Access:** Via the model shape settings in the settings menu. - **Functionality:** Select different sizes and see real-time changes in the model's body parts. - **Software model function:** Visualizes clothing pressure on the body, useful for tight-fitting garments. - **Example:** Simulating a yoga suit shows waist squeezing and chest movement, enhancing realism. --- ## Pattern Generation and Editing Tools This section covers the CLO pattern generator and pattern editing features supporting beginners and students in clothing design. ### Pattern Generator Methods - **Size chart input:** Generate patterns for T-shirts, pants, shorts, skirts by inputting or importing size data (manual entry or Excel). - **AI generation:** Create patterns by inputting prompts or uploading images, e.g., half skirts with circle or A-line styles. - **Size adjustment:** Modify pattern dimensions such as front length or hem length interactively. - **Automatic arrangement:** Generated 2D patterns are automatically positioned and sewn around the virtual model. ### Pattern Editing - **Adding seams:** Use straight or curve tools to add seams (e.g., sleeves) with adjustable width and length. - **Sewing:** Newly created seams automatically complete sewing. - **Combining garments:** Example of combining a top and skirt to form a dress skirt by adjusting hems and sewing waist panels. - **Dividing garments:** Use internal line tools to split skirts into multiple pieces. - **Layering:** Create multi-layer skirts by adding seams and adjusting inner and outer layer lengths. --- ## Fabric Application and Physical Properties with Cloud5 This section explains fabric selection, application, and physical property settings in CLO, particularly using the Cloud5 feature. - **Fabric materials:** Users can download or import fabric data. - **Cloud5 function:** Select fabric type and input composition, weight, thickness, and other parameters.

chunks.content: - **Dividing garments:** Use internal line tools to split skirts into multiple pieces. - **Layering:** Create multi-layer skirts by adding seams and adjusting inner and outer layer lengths. --- ## Fabric Application and Physical Properties with Cloud5 This section explains fabric selection, application, and physical property settings in CLO, particularly using the Cloud5 feature. - **Fabric materials:** Users can download or import fabric data. - **Cloud5 function:** Select fabric type and input composition, weight, thickness, and other parameters. - **Big data matching:** System automatically matches input parameters to reference fabrics, speeding up fabric selection. - **Texture library:** Includes preloaded fabric texture patterns. - **Application:** Fabric can be applied to different garment parts (e.g., pants bottom, sides, sleeves). - **Example:** Applying different fabrics to sleeves and main garment areas. --- ## Pattern and Texture Editing, Including PBR Map Generation This section describes how to add textures and prints directly in CLO and generate physically based rendering (PBR) maps. - **Texture assignment:** Select fabric, open texture properties, and assign images for surface design. - **Texture editing:** Adjust texture position and scale within the software. - **PBR map auto-generation:** Generate maps such as albedo, normal, transparency, and metalness automatically. - **Example:** Creating a honeycomb and flower pattern with adjustable elasticity and simulating realistic fabric behavior. --- ## Virtual Model Pose Generation and Adjustment This section details pose creation and editing for virtual models using AI and manual tools. -
